correctness.rationale: Exact product-to-sum integration gives I_n=[X_n(R+n²)+Y_n(R−n²)]/[(a²+(omega+n)²)(a²+(omega−n)²)], denominator positive for a>0. Even numerator (E−Y)n²+(E+Y)R and odd numerator (O+Y)n²+(O−Y)R; all infinite mode signs equivalent to the two even endpoints/slope and two odd endpoints/slope. For n≥2 admissible coefficients are strictly positive; Vandermonde frequencies 2,...,N+1 give strict positive definiteness. At integer omega Y=0 and E,O>0. Uniform offset omega=k+u/k and global bound on |Y| imply limiting admissible |u|≤a(1−q)/(pi q), with compactness showing the excluded exterior. Independently evaluated 21 damp/frequency pairs, 160 modes each, and 105 numerical quadratures; not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Asymptotics only fixed a>0 and k→∞; no uniform damping boundary or higher-sphere claim.
